אָב 1101 _n.m_. **father**
**1.** **father of individual**
**2.** of God as **father of his people**
**3.** **head of household**, family or clan
**4.** **ancestor**
**5.** **originator** or **patron** of a class, profession, or art
**6.** fig. of **producer**, **generator**
**7.** fig. of **benevolence** & protection
**8.** term of **respect** & **honor**
**9.** specif., **ruler**, **chief** (late)

**1.** **fresh**, **young ears** of barley [[02-exodus.9.31|Ex 9:31]]; indef. [[03-leviticus.2.14|Lv 2:14]] מִנְחַת בִּכּוּרִים לַיהוָה א׳ קָלוּי בָּאֵשׁ.
**2.** חֹדֶשׁ הָֽאָבִֽיב month of ear-forming, or of growing green, **Abib**, month of Exodus & passover, [[02-exodus.13.4|Ex 13:4]] [[02-exodus.23.15|23:15]] [[02-exodus.34.18|34:18]], [[02-exodus.34.18|18]] (JE), [[05-deuteronomy.16.1|Dt 16:1]], [[05-deuteronomy.16.1|1]] (1st month = c. April = הָרִאשֹׁן, הַחֹדֶשׁ הָר׳ (q.v.) in P; v. Di [[02-exodus.12.2|Ex 12:2]]; = postexilic נִיסָן q.v.)
25: גִּבְעוֹן _n.pr.loc_. Levitical city in tribe of Benjamin; cf. also as n.pr.m.
26:
אֲבִיגַ֫יִל _n.pr.f_. (**my father is joy** (?))
**1.** wife of Nabal, then of David
**2.** sister of David
27: אֲבִידָן _n.pr.m_. (**my father is judge**) a prince of Benj.
28: אֲבִידָע _n.pr.m_. (**my father took knowledge**) a son of Midian
29:
אֲבִיָּ֫הוּ _n.pr.m_. & _f_. (**Yah**(**u**) **is** (**my**) **father**)—so † [[14-2-chronicles.13.20|2 Ch 13:20]], [[14-2-chronicles.13.21|21]] = אֲבִיָּם † [[11-1-kings.14.31|1 K 14:31]] [[11-1-kings.15.1|15:1]], [[11-1-kings.15.7|7]], [[11-1-kings.15.7|7]], [[11-1-kings.15.8|8]] (𝔊 _Ἀβιου_, _Ἀβια_); = אֲבִי † [[12-2-kings.18.2|2 K 18:2]] (𝔊 _Ἀβου_, _Ἀβουθ_); = אֲבִיָּה [[09-1-samuel.8.2|1 S 8:2]] 22 t.—
**1.** king of Judah, son & successor of Rehoboam
**2.** 2nd son of Samuel
**3.** son of Jerob.
**4.** son of Becher, a Benjamite
**5.** head of a priestly house
**6.** _id_.
**7.** wife of Hezron
**8.** mother of Hezekiah
30: אֲבִיהוּא _n.pr.m_. (**he is father**) a son of Aaron
31: אֲבִיהוּד _n.pr.m_. (**my father is majesty**) son of Bela, a Benjamite
32:
אֲבִיחַ֫יִל _n.pr.m_. & _f_. (**my father is might**)—prob. = אֲבִיהַיִל
**1.** a Levite
**2.** a Gadite
**3.** father of Esther
**4.** wife of Abishur
**5.** wife of Rehoboam
35: אֲבִיּוֹנָה _n.f_. **caper-berry** (as stimulating desire) [[21-ecclesiastes.12.5|Ec 12:5]] (v. GFM JBL 1891, 55 ff.; so 𝔊 𝔙, Mish. אביונות, cf. NHWB; v. also 𝔖; i.e. _capparis spinosa_, cf. Ri HWB; so Thes, Ew De, etc.; but Wetzst in De (Germ. ed. 1875) proposes אֶבְיוֹנָה (as fem. of אביון) **the poor soul** in sense = נִשְׁמָתוֹ הָאֶבְיוֹנָה cf. Symm 𝔖, where double translation).
36: אֲבִיטוּב _n.pr.m_. (**my father is goodness**) son of Shaharaim, a Benjamite [[13-1-chronicles.8.11|1 Ch 8:11]].
37: אֲבִיטָ֑ל _n.pr.f_. (**my father is** (**the**) **dew**) a wife of David [[10-2-samuel.3.4|2 S 3:4]] [[13-1-chronicles.3.3|1 Ch 3:3]].

39: אֲבִימָאֵל _n.pr.m_. (**a father is Ēl**; South-Arab. name) son of Jokatan
40:
אֲבִימֶ֫לֶךְ _n.pr.m_. (**Melek** (= Malik, Molech) **is father**)
**1.** king of Gerar
**2.** king of Gath
**3.** son of Gideon
**4.** priest, son of Abiathar
41:
אֲבִינָדָב _n.pr.m_. (**my father is noble**)
**1.** a man of Gibeah, in whose house the ark tarried
**2.** a son of Jesse
**3.** a son of Saul
42: אֲבִינֹ֫עַם _n.pr.m_. (**my father is delight**) father of Barak
43: אֲבִיאָסָף _n.pr.m_. (**my father has gathered**) son (descendant) of Korah [[02-exodus.6.24|Ex 6:24]], Sam. אביסף, so אֶבְיָסָף [[13-1-chronicles.6.8|1 Ch 6:8]], [[13-1-chronicles.6.22|22]] [[13-1-chronicles.9.19|9:19]] (cf. Nes Eg 185).
44:
אֲבִיעֶ֫זֶר _n.pr.m_. (**my father is help**)—= אִיעֶזֶר [[04-numbers.26.30|Nu 26:30]]—
**1.** a Manassite, called ‘son’ of Gilead
**2.** a Benjamite, a warrior of David
46: [אָבִיר] _adj_. **strong**; alw. = subst. **the Strong**, old name of God (poet.)
48:
אֲבִירָם _n.pr.m_. ((**the**) **Exalted One is** (**my**) **father**)
**1.** a Reubenite, son of Eliab
**2.** son of Hiel the Bethelite
49: אֲבִישַׁג _n.pr.f_. (**my father is a wanderer** (שׁגג) ?) a handmaid of David
50:
אֲבִישׁוּעַ _n.pr.m_. (**my father is rescue**, or **is opulence**)
**1.** a son of Phinehas
**2.** a Benjamite, son of Bela
51: אֲבִישׁוּר _n.pr.m_. (**my father is a wall**) son of Shammai
52: אֲבִישַׁי _n.pr.m_. (**my father is Jesse**)—grandson of Jesse; son of Zeruiah & brother of Joab
53:
אֲבִישָׁלוֹם _n.pr.m_. (**my father is peace**)
**1.** Rehob.’s father-in-law
**2.** 3rd son of Dvd
54: אֶבְיָתָר _n.pr.m_. (**the Great One is father** (?)) a priest, son of Ahimelech

**1.** **meadow** (?)
**2.** _n.pr.loc_. city in N. Isr.; = א׳ מַיִם
**3.** אָבֵל הַשִּׁטִּים _n.pr.loc_. (= **acacia-meadow**) in lowlands of Moab

**6.** אָבֵל מִצְרַיִם _n.pr.loc_. (= **meadow of Egypt**, i.e. fertile as Egypt ?) E. of Jordan

אֶ֫בֶן 274 _n.f_. **stone**
**1.** in natural state
**2.** **stone**, as material
**3.** **precious stone**, gen. with modifying word
**4.** **stone containing metal**, = **ore**
**5.** **a weight**, as orig. stone
**6.** **plummet**
**7.** objects like stone
**8.** in sim. (mostly poet.) of sinking in water
**9.** In topogr. terms
71:
אֲמָנָה _n.pr.fl_.
**1.** a river (**constant** ? cf. [[23-isaiah.33.16|Is 33:16]]) flowing down from Antilebanon into the plain of Damascus [[12-2-kings.5.12|2 K 5:12]] (Qr; אֲבָנָה Kt)
**2.** the region from which it flows [[22-song-of-songs.4.8|Ct 4:8]].

74: אֲבִינֵר _n.pr.m_. (**my father is Nêr**, or **is a lamp**)—cousin of Saul, and captain of host
81: [אֲבָקָה or אַבְקָה] _n.f_. prob. coll. [[22-song-of-songs.3.6|Ct 3:6]] **powders** _of merchant_ = scent-powders
83: אֵ֫בֶר _n.[m.]_ **pinions** (fr. strength, poet. & fig., pl. in sense)
88: אֹבֹת _n.pr.loc_. (**water-skins**) station of Isr. in wildern.
89: אָגֵא _n.pr.m_. (**fugitive**?) father of a hero of David [[10-2-samuel.23.11|2 S 23:11]] (ins. also [[13-1-chronicles.11.13|1 Ch 11:13]] Dr Sm).
91: אֲגָגִי _adj.gent_. of Haman (= Amalekite? so Jew. trad. & cf. Jos. Ant. xi.6.5)
92:
אֲגֻדָּה _n.f_. **band**
**1.** pl. cstr. **bands**, **thongs** (fastening ox-bow) metaph. of fetters of slavery
**2.** **bunch** of hyssop
**3.** abs. **band** of men
**4.** **vault** of the heavens (as fitted together, constructed)
94: אָגוּר _n.pr.m_. (perh. **hireling**; others **gatherer**) son of יָקֶה, an author of proverbs [[20-proverbs.30.1|Pr 30:1]].
